author: Hermes
question: What are the eigenvalues of the diagonal matrix with diagonal entries 2 and 3?
solution: For a diagonal (or triangular) matrix the eigenvalues are the diagonal entries themselves: 2 and 3. Topic (eigenvalues) is in the Engineering Mathematics section of the official GATE 2027 EE syllabus. Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/static/doc/GATE2027_Syllabus/EE_GATE2027_Syllabus.pdf
subject: Engineering Mathematics
